//:
Type-checks the build scripts, which tsconfig.json excludes.

They are excluded there because `next build` type-checks everything in its
include list, and scripts/emit-tokens.ts imports ../../cardpulse. That path
exists on a developer machine and does not exist inside a Vercel build, so
leaving it in the Next project made a deploy fail on a file that never ships.

Run via `npm run verify:types`, which only makes sense where the sibling repo
is checked out. It is not part of the deploy.
